definition: Phi is a series of large language models developed by Microsoft that are open-weights and can run locally on one's device.
details: The initial version, Phi-1, released in June 2023. Phi-3 was released in April 2024. Phi-4-reasoning-vision-15B was released in March 2026. The New York Times considered Phi-3-mini to be Microsoft's push into smaller large language models. Phi-3-mini has 3.8 billion parameters. Phi-3-mini has been compared to GPT-3.5 in terms of capability.
